title: Brian Behm (Founder, Wild Construct; Rooster Teeth emeritus) built the governance in from day one — 'Definite inspiration from Eric Ries Incorruptible'
summary: Brian Behm, creative director and Rooster Teeth alum, says Wild Construct was organised from the start to force its board to measure success on more than revenue, and credits the book directly. He prefaces it by noting the topic is dry because it gets into corporate governance — which is the argument of the book in miniature.
blockquote: You know, and this is very dry because it gets into corporate governance, but we organized Wild Construct from the beginning to force the board to base their success metrics on more than just revenue. Definite inspiration from Eric Ries Incorruptible.
attribution_title: Founder, Wild Construct · Creative Director · Rooster Teeth emeritus
